items.label: S. 4668
items.summary: The Protect College Sports Act of 2026 establishes federal rules governing name, image, and likeness (NIL) agreements for college student athletes, creates limited antitrust exemptions for sports broadcasting rights, and sets standards for student health, safety, transfers, and scholarship protections. It also establishes a competitive grant program to improve broadband, technology, and sports media infrastructure at Historically Black Colleges and Universities (HBCUs).
items.title: Protect College Sports Act of 2026

items.label: H.R. 8800
items.summary: H.R. 8800 sets national defense authorizations for Fiscal Year 2027, addressing military personnel, benefits, health care, acquisition policies, military construction projects, Department of Energy national security programs, and maritime administration activities. It also includes the 'SAVE America Act', which alters federal election voting requirements.
items.title: National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2027

items.label: H.R. 7613

latest_action.text: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation.

items.summary: The ALERT Act addresses aviation safety in response to the January 29, 2025 midair collision near Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport. It introduces new mandates and timelines for collision avoidance technology, such as ADS-B In and ACAS Xa/Xr, across civil aircraft, rotorcraft, and Department of Defense aircraft. It also requires the FAA and Department of Defense to update air traffic control procedures, training, safety management systems, route planning, and coordination protocols.
items.title: ALERT Act

items.label: S. 1383

latest_action.text: Considered by Senate (Message from the House considered). (consideration: CR S1647)

items.summary: The Safeguard American Voter Eligibility Act (or the SAVE America Act) requires individuals to provide documentary proof of U.S. citizenship when registering to vote in federal elections. It also requires voters to present valid photo identification when casting ballots in federal elections, either in person or alongside mail-in ballots. States must check their voter rolls against federal databases to remove noncitizens and establish processes for alternative proof or handling name discrepancies.
items.title: Veterans Accessibility Advisory Committee Act of 2025

items.label: H.R. 4016

latest_action.text: Motion to proceed to consideration of measure made in Senate. (CR S8522)

items.summary: H.R. 4016 provides fiscal year 2026 appropriations for military activities of the Department of Defense, excluding military construction, family housing, Army Corps of Engineers civil works, and nuclear warheads. It sets funding for personnel, operation and maintenance, procurement, research and development, and revolving funds, while establishing strict administrative rules, restrictions, and reporting requirements.
items.title: Department of Defense Appropriations Act, 2026

items.label: S. 2975
items.summary: The PIPELINE Safety Act of 2025 amends federal laws regarding pipeline safety, reauthorizes funding for the Pipeline and Hazardous Materials Safety Administration and related programs through fiscal year 2030, and establishes new requirements and programs related to pipeline inspections, emerging gases, environmental and geological hazards, stakeholder engagement, and emergency response.
items.title: PIPELINE Safety Act of 2025

items.label: S. 3923

latest_action.text: Placed on Senate Legislative Calendar under General Orders. Calendar No. 685.

items.summary: The Weather Research and Forecasting Innovation Reauthorization Act of 2026 aims to improve weather research, forecasting, and prediction capabilities at the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA). It reauthorizes and updates various programs related to severe weather, hurricanes, tsunamis, drought, and fire weather, while also expanding commercial weather data opportunities and artificial intelligence integration.
items.title: Weather Research and Forecasting Innovation Reauthorization Act of 2026

items.label: H.R. 8595
items.summary: H.R. 8595 provides fiscal year 2027 appropriations for national security, the Department of State, and related foreign affairs and international programs. Additionally, Division B of the bill contains the 'Safeguard American Voter Eligibility Act' (SAVE America Act), which imposes new federal requirements for voter registration and voting in federal elections.
items.title: Making appropriations for national security, Department of State, and related programs for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2027, and for other purposes.

items.label: H.R. 2913

latest_action.text: Read the second time. Placed on Senate Legislative Calendar under General Orders. Calendar No. 462.

items.summary: H.R. 2913, the Ukraine Support Act, addresses the ongoing war between Russia and Ukraine by authorizing various forms of economic, diplomatic, and military assistance for Ukraine and allied European nations, while establishing mandatory sanctions, export controls, and import restrictions against Russia and certain foreign actors if specific triggers related to Russian aggression are met.
items.title: Ukraine Support Act

items.label: S. 2120
items.summary: The Older Americans Act Reauthorization Act of 2025 reauthorizes, updates, and funds programs under the Older Americans Act of 1965 through fiscal year 2030. It supports social services, nutrition programs, caregiver support, tribal elder services, and elder abuse prevention for individuals aged 60 and older.
items.title: Older Americans Act Reauthorization Act of 2025

items.label: S. 4189

latest_action.text: Placed on Senate Legislative Calendar under General Orders. Calendar No. 552.

items.summary: The S. 4189 - INSULIN Act of 2026 aims to reduce the out-of-pocket price of certain insulin products for patients in group health plans and individual health insurance coverage, expedite generic and biosimilar competition, and provide grants and resources to help uninsured individuals access affordable insulin.
items.title: INSULIN Act of 2026

items.label: H.R. 471

latest_action.text: Committee on Agriculture, Nutrition, and Forestry Subcommittee on Conservation, Forestry, Natural Resources, and Biotechnology. Hearings held. With printed Hearing: S.Hrg. 119-27.

items.summary: The Fix Our Forests Act establishes new requirements and programs for managing federal, state, tribal, and private lands to reduce wildfire risks, expedite environmental reviews, and improve forest health. It creates an interagency Fireshed Center to predict and assess fires, establishes emergency management projects in high-risk firesheds, reforms litigation procedures for forest management projects, creates community wildfire risk reduction and research programs, expands utilities' ability to manage vegetation near power lines, and provides casualty assistance for wildland firefighters.
items.title: Fix Our Forests Act
